title: KCP reaction_set request (DESIGN.md §10.2, §11.6.1 space/content mutation family)
description: Mutation (meta required; §11.2: every state-changing operation requires meta). Upserts one actor's Reaction under UNIQUE(target_ref, actor_ref, key) with the closed present|removed state (§10.2; gap note KG27): a lightweight mutable presentation signal, not evidence, a vote, consensus, acceptance, attention, or authority (§10.2 spelled). actor_ref is channel-derived (gap note KG5). Registry (shared_space_v1): surface external_client / principal; mapped connector (only for contribution/reaction/upload operations granted to it) (assurance: current login (principal); workload identity (mapped connector)). Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible (gap note KG14 for dual-surface ops).

key.description: Reaction key token (§10.2 Reaction.key); no vocabulary pinned (gap note KG27).

args.description: Caller-suppliable Reaction fields (§10.2 record shape, names verbatim; gap note KG27); the same-space reference-visibility rules and idempotent revision checks apply (§10.2).

commandMeta.description: Command.meta (§11.2). Required on every mutation; idempotency keys are scoped by authenticated actor, operation, and realm; expected_revision drives optimistic concurrency (mismatch is stale-revision).

digestHex.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 value of a §11.8 typed digest; the digest type/domain is fixed by the schema field holding it (§11.8: a bare 32-byte value cannot be substituted across digest fields).

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).

reactionState.description: Closed Reaction.state enum, verbatim §10.2 (§11.8: closed); reaction_set upserts under UNIQUE(target_ref, actor_ref, key) (gap note KG27).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

statusToken.description: Bounded lowercase token for a field DESIGN.md names without pinning a value space; pins the shape without inventing an enum (gap note KG6).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header value; excluded from the idempotency request digest (§11.2).
